data.name: Neerada
data.gender_notes: Neerada is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word नीरद (nīrada), meaning swift as water. In Hindu mythology, Neerada was the name of a celestial musician who played the veena (a traditional Indian string instrument) and was the charioteer of Lord Indra. He was also believed to be a sage and a poet. The name Neerada carries the meaning “Swift as water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neerada usually hope their child will grow to embody swift as water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes swiftness and agility in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Neerada belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Swift as water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neerada total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
